evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫（Chinese Lexical Database）
evidence.field: 院: transmitted 說文 entry, forms, cited usage, sense discussion
evidence.text: The entry records the 阜 section's 院 as 堅也，从𨸏、完聲 and notes the repeated 宀 entry. It also reports the 宀 form 寏, 周垣也，从宀、奐聲, and cites the Qin Shuihudi passage 「巷相直為院，宇相直者不為院」. The database interprets 院 as a wall or enclosure and separately cites Tang courtyard and official-office uses. These attestations support distinct uses, but do not establish every semantic transition or the earliest occurrence of each sense.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫：院

evidence.field: 院: 說文 entries and 段注 editorial discussion
evidence.text: The page records both transmitted accounts: 阜部 院, 堅也，从𨸏完聲; and 宀部 寏, 周垣也，从宀奐聲, with 院 treated as a 阜-based form. 段玉裁 questions the transmitted form and explanation, suggesting the 宀 form may instead be 从宀阮聲 and distinct from the 阜 entry. This is an editorial hypothesis, not a resolution of which account preserves the earlier graph.
evidence.title: 院 yuàn - 漢典

evidence.field: 院: component analysis and displayed historical readings
evidence.text: The page presents 院 as a phonosemantic compound with 阝 as meaning component and 完 as sound component, and identifies 阝 as a component form of 阜. It displays *ɢʷra[n]-s for 院 and hjwenH for Middle Chinese. This is a modern secondary analysis; it does not settle the transmitted 說文 duplication or prove the sound relationship independently.
evidence.title: 院 - Dong Chinese dictionary

evidence.field: 院: senses, cited book evidence, and example dates
evidence.text: The entry cites 廣雅 「院，垣也」 and 玉篇 「院，周垣也」 for wall/enclosure senses; it also lists 唐書 examples for institutional uses and Tang and Song literary examples for courtyard-related uses. Since the page does not establish the source history and exact dates of every quotation, these are attestations of reported uses, not a complete chronology or proof of a wall-to-courtyard-to-institution sequence.
evidence.title: 院 yuàn - 漢典

evidence.field: 院-seal.svg: summary, source links, file history, license
evidence.text: The Commons page identifies the file as a digital vector depicting 院 in Shuowen seal-script style, with source links to several character databases. File history dates this digital rendering to 8 August 2016. The page states public-domain status for the SVG representation and says attribution is appreciated but not required. It is a modern reconstruction/redrawing, not an ancient artifact image; the page describes the intended graph but does not independently authenticate its ancient form.

evidence.source: Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (2014), supplied local rows
evidence.field: sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv: 院 and 完 rows; upstream PDF access attempt
evidence.text: The supplied local table rows give 院 yuàn, MC hjwenH, OC *ɢʷra[n]-s, gloss “wall round a courtyard”; and 完 wán, MC hwan, OC *[ɢ]ˤo[n], gloss “finish (v.).” These are checked local values, with MC transcription and OC reconstruction kept distinct. The upstream PDF was attempted but could not be opened in this browsing session, so these precise values are not represented as externally reverified. The difference between the supplied reconstructions does not by itself prove or disprove the traditional phonetic analysis.

search_audit.query: 院 說文 堅也 从𨸏完聲 寏 段玉裁; 院 秦簡 睡虎地 巷相直為院 古文字 院 字形; 院 廣雅 院垣 玉篇 周垣 唐代 庭院 院 書證; 完 院 Baxter Sagart Old Chinese *ɢʷra[n]-s *[ɢ]ˤo[n]
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Dong, CUHK, 漢典, and Commons pages. The Ministry dictionary search result exposed the transmitted accounts but its page open returned Cache miss. Both official Unihan character queries and the Baxter–Sagart PDF were attempted and inaccessible. Supplied local readings were retained as local checks, not external evidence.

gaps: No primary manuscript or artifact image was inspected for the Qin citation; the CUHK page reports the Shuihudi Qin slip quotation, but the original slip and its precise archaeological dating were not verified here.

The relationship between the 阜-based 院 entry and the 宀-based 寏 entry remains disputed in the transmitted 說文 tradition; the available sources do not establish the earliest construction or resolve 段玉裁's emendation proposal.

完 is named as the sound component in one traditional account, but this research pass did not obtain independent external historical phonology evidence adequate to establish the sound relationship. The supplied Baxter–Sagart rows show differing reconstructions and the upstream table was inaccessible.
The character-specific Unihan records for 院 and 完 were inaccessible; current kMandarin values yuàn and wán are checked only from the supplied local rows, not externally verified.
The sources support wall/enclosure, courtyard, and institution uses, but not exact first dates for every sense or each semantic link. Dictionary gloss order is not used to infer chronology.
The Commons file verifies a current digital drawing's description and stated rights; it is not an ancient artifact image or independent proof of the graph's historical shape.
